what: Gemma 4 26B rules reader on the Final Challenge Instructions PDF and Part 2. A rule is kept only if its quote is in the PDF word for word. Each is then compared in code with mandates/finals_2026.json and the fund's hard limits (fiam/vfinal/config.py HARD, checked every day by fiam/vfinal/checks.py).
